name: omie-mcp-readonly
description: Pergunte sobre o seu Omie em português. Só lê: não cria, altera nem exclui nada no Omie.
long_description: Lets Claude answer questions about your Omie ERP from live data. It can only read: every call that is not a Listar, Pesquisar, Consultar or Obter method is refused on your PC before reaching Omie. Totals and rankings are computed in code, and every call is logged in %APPDATA%\omie-mcp-readonly.
